title: Native-first, independently installable D-Bus connector
summary: Modernise existing native dbusoorexx, do not rewrite its native layer or interpose BSF4ooRexx.
invariants: The original dbusoorexx implementation and dbus.cls API remain the compatibility foundation until a source-level defect justifies change.
Core MUST install, run and test without Alchemy, BSF4ooRexx, ConnectSelector, Queue Fabric, SOAP, JSON-RPC or gRPC.
Optional adapters depend on the native core, never the reverse.
Preserve D-Bus-specific methods, properties, signals, types, bus identity and error semantics.
Do not automatically publish arbitrary ooRexx object methods: inbound dispatch needs explicit registration, signatures and permission policy.
No native backend replacement merely for fashion; require demonstrated improvement and regression evidence.
procedure: Obtain original source and freeze hashes/revisions.
Build and exercise the unmodified native baseline using pinned ooRexx/libdbus.
Regression-test proxies, server objects, signals, properties and marshalling.
Repair demonstrated faults with backward compatibility tests.
Put ConnectSelector and instrumentation adapters in separate packages.
